payload.leagueSummary: NET is a knife fight up top right now: KeithK75 still owns the cleanest overall profile, but CRANK keeps getting paid in net despite a gross game that looks like it was assembled in a garage. MattF and Dan94 are the real ball-striking monsters, while the middle of the board is split between guys who can actually score and guys who are just surviving on short game and vibes. The ugly part? A few players are dragging around putter and approach numbers like dead anchors, so the window is exposing exactly who can contend and who’s just making the leaderboard less attractive.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the league’s best all-around gross engines, but Keith’s net edge says he’s converting that firepower into actual placements better than almost anyone.
CRANK is the funniest net story in the window: the tee game is a tire fire, the gross math is ugly, and somehow the short game keeps dragging him back from the grave.
BigTime and MattF can absolutely stripe it, but BigTime’s putting and penalty-level mess on the greens is keeping all that approach juice from turning into trophies.
